Market Close Report: NASDAQ Composite index closes at 6,908.82 down -119.66 points November 20, 2018, 04:45:10 PM
Tuesday's session closes with the NASDAQ Composite Index at 6,908.82. The total shares traded for the NASDAQ was over 2.62 billion. Declining stocks led advancers by 3.13 to 1 ratio. There were 767 advancers and 2397 decliners for the day. On the NASDAQ Stock Exchange 6 stocks reached a 52 week high and 232 those reaching lows totaled. The most active, advancers, decliners, unusual volume and most active by dollar volume can be monitored intraday on the Most Active Stocks page.
The NASDAQ 100 index closed down -1.75% for the day; a total of -115.96 points. The current value is 6,526.96. Ross Stores, Inc. ( ROST ) had the largest percent change down (-9.38%) while Analog Devices, Inc. ( ADI ) had the largest percent change gain rising 4.09%. The Dow Jones index closed down -2.21% for the day; a total of -551.8 points. The current value is 24,465.64. Apple Inc.
